title: Free Time and Hobbies

story.title: Jasur’s new hobby
story.text: Jasur is sixteen. A year ago, he spent all his **free time** at home. He **played computer games** for hours, and his mum was not happy. | One day his uncle gave him an old camera. At first Jasur thought it was **boring**, but then he started to **take photos** of the city, people and animals. Now photography is his favourite **hobby**! | Last month he **joined a** photography **club**. They meet every Saturday and **go for a walk** in different parts of the city. Sometimes they visit a **museum** or a **concert** and take pictures there. Jasur says it’s really **exciting**. | He’s also **interested in** music. He’s learning to **play the guitar**, and he practises **at least** thirty minutes every day. He says it’s very **relaxing**. | At the weekend he **meets friends**, they **go to the cinema** or **eat out**. And computer games? He still plays sometimes, but he isn’t really **into** them any more.

Do you prefer staying at home or going out?
I prefer going out. **I’m interested in** films, so I often **go to the cinema**. Staying at home all weekend is **boring** for me.
speech: Hi! Let me tell you about my free time. **In my free time I love** playing chess. **I got into it when** I was eight – my grandpa taught me. **I do it about** three **times a week**, usually online, and sometimes I play with my grandpa in the park. **I’m not very good at it, but** I’m getting better. **It helps me to** think and **relax**. I’m also **interested in** music, and I go to concerts with my friends. **I’d like to try** dancing **one day**, but I’m a bit shy! Thank you!
